title: Terminal finalization attestation, version 1
description: What the guest reports it did during finalization, published through the VMware Tools guest RPC interface before the machine shuts down. Deliberately small: it exists to be read from outside a guest that can no longer be reached, and every field it does not carry is a field that cannot leak. It reports what the guest claims it performed, and is not independent proof against a compromised guest.

runId.description: The build this attestation belongs to. A value from another run is stale, not evidence.

nonce.description: Generated by the host and given to the finalizer. The key is cleared before the finalizer launches, so a value carrying this nonce is one this run wrote rather than one a previous build left behind.

outcome.description: passed only when every step passed. A finalizer reporting anything else must not have shut the machine down.

reasonCode.description: Present when and only when the outcome is failed. Bounded: a free-text message would quote whatever it failed on, which is how paths, arguments, and credentials escape.

steps.description: One entry per finalization step, in the order performed. Names only, with outcomes: what happened, never how.
